result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The clearest defect is the '−100%' badge on the second 'Popular right now' card, which appears to be a malformed or miscalculated promo value. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between the two cards.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−100%' badge. A 100% discount implies the food is free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting error. It is also unclear whether it refers to the food price or the delivery fee (the card above uses '€0 delivery' for the free-delivery case).
issues.suggestion: Check the discount value and badge formatting logic. Show the correct percentage, or use the same '€0 delivery' wording if it means free delivery. Hide the badge when the value is invalid.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons are styled inconsistently. On the Tokumaru Ramen card the button's dark circular background blends into the dark image and is barely distinguishable. On the pizza card below, the dark circle is clearly visible against the lighter image.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent, clearly visible container (for example a white or semi-opaque light circle with a subtle shadow) so it reads the same on any image.
